turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first; start there.
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
Frazzled. That's not Owen's problem. Who decided to enter that zero before anyone picked up a phone?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Don't manage me, Hale. I haven't agreed to anything. Did anyone speak to Owen before that mark went in?
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Then why are we here? Kindness would have been a phone call before my son read a zero off his phone in front of his class. On what basis did you give it?
